title: Junior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Ash is a scale-up building logistics apps. We are looking for a junior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Oldmoor.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will improve app performance and stability, work closely with design and product and build offline-first features.

Four-day weeks in summer.
